components.functionality: React/Vite administrative GUI, layout, navigation, dashboard, providers, models, OAuth, API keys, usage, quotas, logs, settings, hooks, state, CSS and themes
FastAPI OpenAI proxy, Codex OAuth execution, model listing, request middleware and SSE streaming
Ledger, usage accounting, budget guard, quota policies, account rotation, routing and history
CODEX_HOME, auth.json, profiles, cache, configuration and isolation
Direct runtime bridge from FastAPI to the upstream usage ledger and budget guard
components.incompatibility: FastAPI cannot import the TypeScript module in-process, so this bridge only translates JSON across a Node subprocess while executing the upstream compiled functions unchanged.

parityAudit.decision: The adapter exposes only the governance operations required by AIWrapper and executes the original upstream implementation without replacing it.

components.functionality: Budget allow/deny evaluation used before every Codex request
components.incompatibility: FastAPI cannot import the TypeScript budget guard in-process, so the bridge translates JSON and calls evaluateBudgetGuard from the unchanged compiled upstream package.

retained: Original request, token and cost limits
parityAudit.decision: The upstream evaluator is executed directly; AIWrapper only maps a user quota to its documented input contract.

components.functionality: Account policy store available for future multi-OAuth routing
components.incompatibility: The current laboratory topology intentionally has one shared ChatGPT OAuth account, so selecting among multiple OAuth accounts would be misleading and is not on the request path.

retained: Complete upstream account policy implementation in the copied package
parityAudit.decision: Keep the mature upstream module intact and label it honestly as not wired until the topology has multiple OAuth identities.

components.functionality: Project routing profiles available for future multi-OAuth routing
components.incompatibility: A per-user quota gateway backed by one ChatGPT OAuth account has no alternate account target to route to; activating this module would falsely suggest provider-side quota isolation.

retained: Complete upstream routing profile store and resolution implementation
parityAudit.decision: The module is preserved byte-for-byte and explicitly not wired until multiple independently authorized OAuth accounts are configured.

components.functionality: Health-based account rotation available for future multi-OAuth routing
components.incompatibility: Rotation requires at least two independently authenticated upstream accounts. AIWrapper currently governs several local users over one OAuth account, so rotating would not change the provider quota owner.

retained: Complete upstream health score and token bucket rotation implementation
parityAudit.decision: Preserve the original implementation and avoid a fake integration until a genuine multi-account topology is introduced.

components.functionality: FastAPI adapter invoking the original codex-profile executable through Bash
components.incompatibility: The upstream interface is a Bash executable while FastAPI needs an asynchronous Python call boundary; the adapter launches the unchanged executable instead of porting profile behavior.

parityAudit.decision: No profile logic is reimplemented; additional upstream commands remain available through the copied package and can be exposed later.

components.functionality: Individual-key gate, AIWrapper API client and page integration frame
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex authenticates its own management API but has no AIWrapper per-user key principal, organization permission gate or cross-service client for the Codex-Wrapper extension API; adaptation alone cannot create those domain-specific contracts.

retained: OpenCodex visual tokens and error conventions at the integration boundary
parityAudit.decision: This is an allowed AIWrapper-specific permissions and integration layer; it does not replace the OpenCodex API client used by upstream pages.

components.functionality: Chat, new/continued sessions, model and effort selection, streaming and response timing
components.project: OpenCodex and Codex-Wrapper (reviewed; no upstream chat UI exists)
components.incompatibility: Neither OpenCodex GUI nor Codex-Wrapper ships a multi-user persisted chat and session UI. OpenCodex Logs cannot be adapted because it displays proxy logs rather than composing or resuming Codex conversations.

retained: OpenCodex page composition and loading/error style
parityAudit.decision: Chat and Sessions are explicitly permitted AIWrapper-owned features and remain outside the imported OpenCodex page modules.

components.functionality: Users, organizations, roles and editable 5-hour/7-day quotas
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex API Keys manages provider credentials, not human users, organizations, roles or individual budgets. Reusing it would conflate security domains and omit the required user lifecycle.

retained: OpenCodex cards, tables, controls, loading and error patterns
parityAudit.decision: Users and Organizations are explicitly permitted domain extensions and do not replace OpenCodex API Keys.

components.functionality: Conversation sharing administration
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex has storage administration but no ACL-backed conversation share entity or public share lifecycle that could be adapted.

parityAudit.decision: Conversation Sharing is an explicitly permitted AIWrapper extension and leaves OpenCodex Storage intact.

components.functionality: Internal quota allocation and billing summary
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex Usage reports provider traffic but does not allocate an internal subscription budget across AIWrapper users or organizations.

parityAudit.decision: Billing is an explicitly permitted AIWrapper extension and the original OpenCodex Usage page remains unchanged and available.

components.functionality: Users, organizations, sessions, messages, sharing and permission endpoints attached to Codex-Wrapper
components.incompatibility: Codex-Wrapper exposes only OpenAI-compatible proxy routes and has no user, organization, persisted session, share, role or individual-key domain model to adapt.

retained: FastAPI dependency injection and HTTP error boundary conventions
parityAudit.decision: These domain endpoints are explicitly permitted AIWrapper features; Codex execution, SSE, OAuth and OpenAI compatibility remain in upstream main.py.

components.functionality: Containerized Codex-Wrapper runtime with copied governance and profile packages
components.incompatibility: The upstream image only copies Codex-Wrapper; AIWrapper must additionally compile and copy the unmodified multi-auth package and original profile executable used by its thin adapters.

parityAudit.decision: The upstream container architecture is retained and extended only with the two required upstream packages and AIWrapper integration boundary.

components.functionality: Container image for the imported OpenCodex server and GUI fork
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex has no upstream Dockerfile to import. Its Bun package scripts are therefore invoked unchanged from a minimal container integration file.

parityAudit.decision: The container adds packaging only and executes the imported OpenCodex server and GUI without replacing either implementation.

components.functionality: Container-only OpenCodex bind configuration
components.incompatibility: OpenCodex has a configuration schema but no container bind configuration; a two-field instance is required so the unchanged server can listen outside its container namespace.

parityAudit.decision: This is deployment data consumed by the upstream loader and contains no replacement configuration logic.

components.functionality: Local composition of OpenCodex and Codex-Wrapper services
components.incompatibility: The upstream compose starts only Codex-Wrapper and cannot compose the independently imported OpenCodex management server, multi-auth state volume and AIWrapper profile adapter paths.

parityAudit.decision: Service composition is an allowed integration layer; each service continues running its upstream runtime rather than a replacement.

components.functionality: Pairwise source/destination provenance manifest, metrics and unified diff generation
components.incompatibility: The upstream generator verifies vendored SHA-256 values but does not compare arbitrary origin/destination pairs or emit line metrics and unified diffs required by AIWrapper.

parityAudit.decision: The upstream manifest architecture is preserved and extended with required pairwise evidence rather than replaced.

components.functionality: Fail-closed verification of hashes, classifications, diffs and parity audits
components.incompatibility: The upstream verifier has no AIWrapper literal classification, pairwise diff integrity or mandatory own-code incompatibility checks.

parityAudit.decision: Upstream verification behavior is retained and strengthened for the acceptance policy.
